hooks.name: Block tree-wide git staging across concurrent sessions
hooks.description: Refuses `git add .` / `-A` / `-u`, `git commit -a`, and bare `git stash`, and asks before `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f`, tree-wide checkout/restore and force push. Local Kiro sessions share one working tree and one git index with no merge step, so a tree-wide stage in one session captures another session's half-finished edits. Measured 2026-09-20: three warm sessions on this workspace with four unrelated modified files.

action.command: D=/Users/wecaredigital/wecare-digital/wecare-digital; if [ -x "$D/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "$D/.venv/bin/python" "$D/scripts/block_broad_git_staging.py"; else exec /usr/bin/python3 "$D/scripts/block_broad_git_staging.py"; fi
